FREMONT, Calif., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Enphase Energy, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_4v5RTwDHsITEQNp0KbxKjSd4x0dzRHE_bjGWXIm_PeaWgORrd74jwMvWu5dC8Ry2qaLHmO01DfbBzpxz_Donw0BCkOoMhc4KHjtHImCP_s=) (NASDAQ: ENPH), a global energy technology company, today announced that it began production shipments of its new IQ® Gateway Fusion in India. The compact system works with IQ8™ Microinverters to power homes with solar and keep essential appliances running during daytime power cuts, even without a home battery.


IQ Gateway Fusion combines the IQ® Gateway, IQ® Relay, and a built-in power socket in a single unit. With Enphase Sunlight Backup, the system keeps loads plugged into the socket running on solar when the grid goes down, including home UPS systems, refrigerators, electric scooters, and more. Watch the[video explainer](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Jiid8BuP0y0X-0f0QchXm7okLLYOGrUZHUwftk-SYB2TCsdFsCVCj0jZG9xfl5APTLAxPeUPNUtoLDq4vo11_awrKdPimEDeylq-aflKH78=) to see how it works.


For the millions of Indian households that rely on a UPS during outages, IQ Gateway Fusion can be paired with UPS batteries with solar during the day. This extends backup runtime and reduces how much the UPS draws from the grid. If a power cut runs through the night and drains the UPS, the system starts recharging it with sunlight the next morning, even if the grid is still down. When the grid is up, the system powers home loads with solar and exports excess energy to the grid to help lower electricity bills.


Each IQ Gateway Fusion supports up to 3,680 W of output with up to seven IQ8P™ or nine IQ8HC™ Microinverters. Homeowners can start small and expand over time. The IP65-rated unit fits on terraces, small rooftops, and compact homes. Installers can set it up quickly with simple cabling and commissioning through the Enphase® Installer App. Homeowners can monitor production and system health from anywhere with the Enphase® App.


"Power cuts are part of daily life for many of our customers, and most already own a UPS," said Thejas Babu, managing director at Thapas Energy, Kerala. "IQ Gateway Fusion lets them charge that UPS with sunlight, so their backup lasts longer when they need it most."


"Installation is fast and clean," said Srinivasan Dona Balasubramaniam, managing director at AARA Solar Energy Pvt. Ltd., Tamil Nadu. "One unit replaces several components, and we can commission the system in minutes from the app."


"Homeowners want solar that keeps working when the grid doesn't," said Dijo, managing director at 3rd Eye Security Systems, Kerala. "IQ Gateway Fusion gives them that at a price point that makes sense for Indian homes."


"Indian homeowners shouldn't lose access to their own solar power when the grid goes down," said Sunil Thamaran, senior vice president and managing director of India at Enphase Energy. "IQ Gateway Fusion delivers daytime backup and smarter UPS charging in a simple, compact system that our installers can deploy quickly.”


To learn more, visit the Enphase website for[homeowners](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=1Bl2EhTF5lDxE4uIHQmwTrLMnGj6lbD9np7gmIF_DI8wW4Xi4R3ExYY9EJ6YU3v43NdlPG8Iv6BDud49IAGeH-UHGjZ8W3QDwaYF-YZHh1WnZhbPUzv1sO4eru2dIeP2) and[installers](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=y5g82rgXC0UwY98Rt4jClUl9SWD0QuRYCeDGI4flob_k3AVg5xS3ShYi-p1rafEgnXLy29Yhl-fmJy0QkUkqQ3dsIu7eApwR3V2_ZM1EdueojJdV9CTHMkgddmHaYQuP) .


**About Enphase Energy, Inc.**


Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company advancing intelligent power systems for homes, businesses, and next-generation AI data centers. The company designs semiconductor-based energy technologies spanning solar, batteries, EV charging, energy management, and virtual power plants, and is developing solid-state transformer technology to address the rapidly growing power demands of AI data centers. Based in Fremont, California, Enphase is the world’s leading supplier of microinverter-based solar and battery systems. The company revolutionized the solar industry with its microinverter technology and has shipped approximately 89.4 million microinverters, with approximately 5.3 million Enphase-based systems deployed in more than 165 countries. Enphase products enable people to harness the sun to make, use, save, and sell their own power, all controlled through the Enphase App. For more information, visit[https://enphase.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Je889QP8QxeInjkf7dFlt0WYIF4X6PGXjkfQ94MW-7qqksYBgI0VnaWemsw4deU9WATQz8RtWfzJ9-WacVU-qBelcDcJrzGxBaCoGRHVHlU=) .
